Definition: Karka (with the article prefix), a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Karka is a place on the southern border of Judah. It is named where the border fetched a compass to Karkaa after passing Hezron and Adar.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the single mention as the mark of a real border town, fixed on the map by the lot of Judah.
